{{Quote|I am Aristocra Sev'eere'nuruodo of the Second Ruling Family of the Chiss Ascendancy. You will receive no other information from me as long as you hold me captive.|Sev'eere'nuruodo|<ref name="CotBHP">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref>}}
'''Aristocra''' was a title of high rank within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], borne by important members of at least some of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]].

==Overview==
Along with the teachings in the [[Chiss Academy]], the values of the ruling Aristocra led to a cultural taboo within [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] society against preemptive strikes to the extent that use of the tactic<ref name="ETU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref> was [[Defensive-only doctrine|legally]]<ref name="Joiner King" /> punishable by [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="ETU" />

Aristocras were found serving as heads of a military or diplomatic expeditions as well as representatives of their Family or even of the Ascendancy as a whole, charged with carrying out a specific mission and enjoying wide-ranging authority in the execution of the resultant duties. They might serve as envoys in contacts with outsiders, as civilian leaders of a military expedition, as the primary representatives of their Family's interests in a particular area of space, or as commanders of private military ventures designed to strengthen their Family's stance against other power blocs within the Ascendancy.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref><ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> An Aristocra also outranked [[General/Legends|generals]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> On their own authority, Aristocras could also arraign an officer of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Fleet]] for trial and take him into custody&mdash;even in the face of objections from an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[Defense Hierarchy]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Two individuals bearing the title of Aristocra were [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> and [[Mitt'swe'kleoni]].<ref name="Joiner King" /> Chaf'orm'bintrano was a representative of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Chaf family]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Chiss [[Sev'eere'nuruodo]] was Aristocra of the [[Nuruodo family]].<ref name="CotBHP" />
